note: CPU only; models loaded by local path, modelFitPolicy off

is_fin.instructions: This message reports a completed money transaction: money actually moved (sent, received, paid, withdrawn, deposited, borrowed or repaid).

direction.instructions: From the point of view of the phone owner, which way did the money move?

criteria.in: money came into the owner's account or wallet
criteria.out: money left the owner's account or wallet
criteria.neutral: no money moved (reminder, promotion, code, balance, chat)

category.instructions: What was the money spent on or received for?

criteria.transport: matatu, taxi, fuel, bus fare, ride hailing
criteria.bills_utilities: electricity, water, rent, TV, internet, insurance, school fees, paybill bills
criteria.shopping: clothes, electronics, hardware, online shopping, general retail
criteria.loans_credit: loans, borrowing, repaying loans, Fuliza, credit, lender
criteria.transfer_p2p: sending or receiving money from a person or business
criteria.cash_agent: cash withdrawal or deposit at an agent or ATM
criteria.other: anything else: salary, health, fees, or not a transaction

loan_due.instructions: This message tells the owner that a loan or loan repayment is due, overdue or must be paid.

models.policy: NOT in policy.json (default-deny, D36): add an entry before shipping
